newsitem.title: INDIA: India L&T Q1 orders at 15.38 bln rupees.
newsitem.headline: India L&T Q1 orders at 15.38 bln rupees.

text.p: Indian engineering and construction firm Larsen & Toubro Ltd said on Friday that it booked orders worth 15.38 billion rupees in the first quarter of 1997/98 (April-March).
"We expect improved order booking in the latter half of the year," a company statement said.
"The order book position for the year as a whole is expected to be satisfactory," it added.
The statement was released at the firm's annual meeting of shareholders on Friday which was chaired by S.S. Marathe, a director.
The major order it won was a 3.69-billion-rupee combined cycle cogeneration plant at Haldia in eastern West Bengal state for HPL Cogeneration Ltd.
It bagged the contract for the construction of a causeway and equipment supply, worth 960 million rupees, for a refinery being set up by Reliance Petroleum Ltd in Jamnagar in western Gujarat state.
The firm also got a 480-million-rupee contract for civil and structural works at Kayamkulam in southern Kerala for Daelim Engineering Ltd.
